short: Swimming stops putting your weapon away. Swords, pickaxes and fishing rods stay in hand in deep water, at a higher stamina price per swing.

roadmap.title: Check swinging and hitting in deep water in game
roadmap.body:
Two things only the running game can answer: whether the swing animation plays sensibly while you swim, and whether a blow reaches something in or under the surface.

The first play test settles both, and anything that looks wrong is fixed before the mod is released.
